Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: UFAZ Hub collects the information needed to run a student knowledge library.
Privacy.accountBody: When you create an account, we store your email address, display name, password hash and the profile details you choose to add. Contributions, votes, bookmarks and moderation records are stored to operate the service.
Privacy.sessionsBody: We use an HTTP-only refresh cookie and a CSRF cookie to keep your session secure. A language preference cookie remembers your selected language for one year. You can clear these in your browser.
Privacy.activityBody: Content pages show aggregate view counts. The platform does not use third-party advertising trackers.
Privacy.contactBody: For access, correction or deletion requests, contact the UFAZ Hub administrators through the university's usual support channel.
